en.description:
BuddyPlay is 22 two-player games in one app. Pass one phone back and forth, or put two phones on the same Wi-Fi and play across them.

THE GAMES
Chess · Checkers · Reversi · Connect Four · Battleship · Ludo · Mancala · Nim · Mastermind · Tic-Tac-Toe · Ultimate Tic-Tac-Toe · Dots and Boxes · Hangman · Word Duel · Trivia Battle · Twenty Questions · Pong · Air Hockey · Racer · Snake Battle · Tank Battle · Coin Flip & Dice.

TWO PHONES, NO SERVER
Host a match and your phone shows a pairing code. The other player joins over the same Wi-Fi network or your phone's hotspot — the two devices talk to each other directly over the local network. Nothing is relayed through a server, nothing needs an internet connection, and there is no account to create.

RIVALRIES
BuddyPlay remembers who you play and keeps the running score. Clear it whenever you like.

QUIET BY DESIGN
No ads. No sign-up. No analytics profile. Haptic feedback and a default game are the only settings you need to think about.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
BuddyPlay is 22 two-player games in one app. Pass one phone back and forth, or put two phones on the same Wi-Fi and play across them.

Intended audience:
22 two-player games, offline

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
No account and no login are required. Every feature is reachable from the first screen after launch.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
None. The app works entirely on the device and calls no external service.

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app ships 12 languages (Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), English, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish). Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
The app creates no account, so there is nothing to delete.
